caption: The drawing depicts a single figure standing atop a two-tiered, rectangular pedestal. The figure is dressed in a jester or clown-like costume that consists primarily of green, red, and yellow colors. The costume includes tight green sleeves and pants, with red and yellow ornamental patterns on the chest and legs, as well as around the cuffs. The collar is a large, ruffled, tan-colored piece. The figure wears a tall, pointed red hat decorated with green and yellow patterns and topped with a large yellow ball. The shoes are black with gold rosettes, and the white ruffled ends of the pants are visible just below the knee. The figure's left arm is bent at the elbow, with the hand positioned near the chest, while the right arm is extended outward, palm up. The face is human-like, with a wide smile, pronounced cheeks, and visible eyes, nose, and mouth. The background of the image is plain and unadorned. There is a signature near the bottom right corner.
title: Cigar Store Figure: Punch
